## Validation / 验证

- [ ] Relevant CI passes, or the reason CI is not applicable is documented. / 相关 CI 已通过，或已说明不适用原因。
- [ ] Hardware validation is recorded, or marked not applicable with a reason. / 已记录实机验证，或说明不适用原因。
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation are updated together when user-visible behavior changes. / 用户可见行为变化时，中英文文档已同步更新。
- [ ] Firmware and SD-card artifact impact is documented; checksums are updated when applicable. / 已说明固件和 SD 卡产物影响，并在适用时更新校验值。
- [ ] Public text, logs, commits, and artifacts contain no credentials, private data, or host-specific paths. / 公开文本、日志、提交和产物不含凭据、私人数据或本机专属路径。
- [ ] Attached logs are minimal and redacted. / 附带日志已最小化并完成脱敏。
